decision: The competitor (BWT Alpine F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
fact: The team failed to electronically lodge the return of the tyres.
offence: Breach of Article 30.5 g) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative of Car 43 (Franco Colapinto). Although the tyres were returned physically there is still a responsibility to electronically lodge their return with the FIA and this was not done.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 43 Electronic Return Of Tyres
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team
